headline: Refund rage, a podcast split and a memoir row
intro: A busy day on the timeline. Here's everything the channel covered in the last 24 hours — allegedly.

items.blurb: In a tense 40-minute livestream, the fictional skincare founder blamed a payment processor for weeks of missing refunds. Chat was not convinced.
One half of the fictional comedy podcast says he was 'locked out' of the channel — his co-host has yet to respond.
A former contestant on a fictional dating show pushed back on claims that a ghostwriter did the heavy lifting.
The fictional streamer says a peripherals brand owes her three months of fees; the brand allegedly says she broke exclusivity.
